in_arabic.name: الفرید
in_arabic.long_meaning: الفرید اسم من اسماء الله الحسنیٰ، یعنی وہ جو ایک فطرت کا مالک ہے، واحد و تنہا ہے، کسی کے شریک یا مثل نہیں ہے، اور مخلوقات میں کسی کی مانند نہیں ہے۔{سورہ يس، ١٢}

in_urdu.name: الفرید
in_urdu.meaning: واحد اور منفرد، اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: الفرید اللہ تعالیٰ کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے واحد، تنہا، اور منفرد۔ یہ نام اس بات پر دلالت کرتا ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کسی کے شریک یا مثل نہیں ہے، اور اس کی ذات و صفات کسی اور کی مانند نہیں ہے۔{سورہ يس، ١٢}

in_hindi.name: अलफ़रीद
in_hindi.meaning: एक और अद्वितीय, अल्लाह का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलफ़रीद अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है अद्वितीय, एक और अकेला। यह नाम इस बात को दर्शाता है कि अल्लाह किसी के समान या बराबर नहीं है, और उसकी प्रकृति और विशेषताएं किसी और की तरह नहीं हैं।{सूरह यासीन, १२}

in_pashto.name: الفرید
in_pashto.long_meaning: الفرید د الله د نومونو څخه یو دی، چې معنی یې ده یو ځانګړی، تنهال او بې مثاله. دا نوم داسې دلالت کوي چې الله تعالیٰ د کسي شريک يا مثل نه دی، او د هغه ذات او صفات د کسي بل په شان نه دي.{سورہ يس، ١٢}

in_english.name: AlFarid
in_english.meaning: The Unique, One and Only, a name of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: AlFarid is one of the names of Allah, meaning The Unique, One and Only. This name signifies that Allah has no partner or equal, and His attributes and essence are unlike those of any other being. It is derived from the Arabic root 'F-R-D', which conveys the sense of uniqueness and singularity.{Quran, Surah Yasin, 12}

data.cultural_impact: The name AlFarid holds immense cultural significance within the Islamic community. It is regarded as a title rather than just a name and is often used in honorific expressions as an acknowledgement of Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) unique position in Islam. AlFarid can also be thought of as a reminder of the emphasis on individuality, originality, and uniqueness within the Islamic faith.
data.spiritual_significance: However, the spiritual significance of the name AlFarid is arguably even more profound. According to Islamic tradition, this name was given to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) by God Himself. It signifies that the Prophet is the embodiment of perfection, the unique intermediary between God and His creation. The name AlFarid is a reminder that there is only one God, and that Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is His chosen messenger. This name reflects the belief that every individual is uniquely created by God and has the potential to achieve great things in their life. Ultimately, the name AlFarid reminds us of the importance of striving for excellence and seeking closeness with God.
